card.text: The Little Dumbbell Nebula is a planetary nebula about 1,359 parsecs away.

sources.quote: The Little Dumbbell Nebula, also known as Messier 76, NGC 650/651, the Barbell Nebula, or the Cork Nebula, is a planetary nebula in the northern constellation of Perseus.

introduction.text: It is a ring of gas seen almost edge-on with a lobe blown out of each open end; the north-western lobe points toward us.

sources.label: Bryce et al. (1996), A&A 307, 253: a kinematical investigation of the bipolar planetary nebula NGC 650-1
sources.locator: Abstract and Sect. 4.1: a bright central ring with two attached lobes, inclined about 75°, the north-west lobe toward the observer

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Little Dumbbell Nebula"
sources.quote: It was discovered by Pierre Méchain in 1780 and included in Charles Messier's catalog of comet-like objects as number 76.
